_note: Scoring mechanics written for OverScope from Overwatch's published mode rules. The official one-line objective for each mode is loaded live from OverFast /gamemodes and shown alongside this.

control.name: Control
control.scoring: Best of three rounds; the first team to win two rounds takes the map. Each round is played on one of the map's sub-maps. A team scores by holding the single capture point until its percentage reaches 100%.
control.attack: Both teams fight for the same point.
control.defend: Hold the point you own and contest any enemy capture to force overtime.

escort.name: Escort
escort.scoring: Attackers move a payload along a fixed route; each checkpoint reached adds time. Teams then swap sides, and the team that pushes the payload further (or finishes faster) wins.
escort.attack: Stay next to the payload to move it and reach each checkpoint before time runs out.
escort.defend: Contest the payload to stop its progress and win time-out.

hybrid.name: Hybrid
hybrid.scoring: Attackers first capture a point, which unlocks a payload; they then escort it through checkpoints to the end. Teams swap sides and compare progress.
hybrid.attack: Take the first point, then stay on the payload.
hybrid.defend: Hold the first point as long as possible, then stall the payload.

push.name: Push
push.scoring: Both teams fight for control of a central robot that pushes a barricade toward the enemy side. Checkpoints along each route move the pushing team's spawn forward. The team that pushes its barricade furthest wins.
push.attack: Escort the robot while it pushes your barricade.
push.defend: Retake the robot to send it back the other way.

flashpoint.name: Flashpoint
flashpoint.scoring: Capture points activate one at a time across a large map. Capturing a point scores one; the first team to three points wins.
flashpoint.attack: Both teams race to each newly activated point.
flashpoint.defend: Hold the active point and rotate quickly when a new one opens.

clash.name: Clash
clash.scoring: A line of capture points runs between the two spawns. Teams capture points one at a time to push the fight toward the enemy side; win by scoring enough points or by taking the point nearest the enemy spawn.
clash.attack: Capture forward to move the fight toward the enemy spawn.
clash.defend: Recapture to swing the line back.

assault.name: Assault
assault.scoring: Attackers capture two points in sequence; defenders try to stop them before time runs out.
assault.defend: Keep attackers off each point until time expires.
